description: Municipal Parking Lots is a dataset listed in Analyzejerseycity open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Analyzejerseycity. This dataset is linked to the following visualization: Visualization - Municipal Parking Lots Shop Local!! Municipal lots offer free parking for 2 hours from 11/27/2020 - 12/31/2020. Coverage: Jersey City, New Jersey. The portal files it under Community. Its keywords are Parking. The portal shows 7 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-jerseycitynj-gov-portal.
